behavior: Overview component reads existing per-Bot or owner endpoints with explicit GET submission; it adds no backend route or flag.
Owned Bot and broker, or owner and one currency, with calendar periods and inclusive custom UTC dates.
Financial decimal strings remain unrounded strings; null fields retain reasons. No browser financial arithmetic or chart.
Server status, overlays, methods, requested/resolved ranges and pending metadata remain visible. Book equity is explicitly separate and is not derived.
Owner totals require an eligible independent-account declaration; owner TWR/MWR are not displayed.
Selection changes immediately invalidate pending/completed results; HTTP errors, refusal and retry never retain prior financial results.
English/Thai fixed notices; user/API text is inserted with textContent.

validation.fixtureProvenance: Synthetic Bot and owner bodies built from production composers; focused tests run validateResponse and validateOwnerResponse. No real account or private source.
rework: Initial test asserted a human-readable year despite the contract supplying raw millisecond timestamps; the assertion was corrected to compare exact server ranges.
Root review removed invented book-equity reasons and required malformed/REFUSED bodies to remain without financial results.

Independent P2 review found owner numeric aggregates could pass with a non-null version but an ineligible capital model. The bounded guard fix rejects shared/changed declarations and inconsistent currency; three adversarial cases pass.

independentReview.scope: Source mapping, GET-only/auth guards, decimal/null rendering, owner eligibility and stale-response handling; no independent browser execution.

renderContinuation.independentReview: No new blocker. Tester checked source/fixture mapping, all 41 observation records, all 44 complete network cases, interactions and three of 45 saved JPGs. Root performed browser interaction and visual inspection. This review does not independently execute the browser.
renderContinuation.limits: Focused counts overlap earlier runs and must not be added. No broad local suite was repeated.

rendered.ownerGo: Owner explicitly resumed local synthetic desktop/mobile EN/TH rendering on 2026-10-22, with evidence and commit/push; no deploy or target routes.
rendered.browser: Desktop in-app Chromium browser via the supported Computer Use API; mobile is a viewport test, not a physical device.
rendered.screenshotCountExplanation: 36 main states, four custom-date states, four pending states and one extra expanded desktop English Bot view.
rendered.result: Notices and reasons are readable in EN/TH. Exact decimal strings survive; null is an em dash with its reason. Owner currencies remain separate and owner TWR/MWR metrics are absent. All 41 measured observations have scrollWidth equal to clientWidth and no out-of-viewport component elements, including expanded metadata before collapse. Pending views disable Load, show no financial result, and selection changes clear the request state.
rendered.customDates: All four surfaces accepted 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-02 and sent CUSTOM/from/to in GET. The fixed synthetic response retains its own requested/resolved range and RANGE_END_AT_REQUEST_TIME; the stub does not compute financial results for arbitrary dates.

network.scope: Only this synthetic component harness. Per-case CDP capture includes navigation, assets, Bot-list and report requests. Embedded data SVG calendar icons are not external traffic.

collectionCorrections: Initial ignored harness CSS named loginPanel instead of the actual login section; corrected to hide the unrelated login panel before counted captures. Product assets were unchanged.
The initial aggregate CDP buffer was truncated. It is retained as diagnostic network.json only. All 44 cases were repeated for complete per-case network collection; screenshots were not recounted.

Unrelated scripts/images/icons and app shell/other Overview panels are removed or hidden. CSP restricts self/data. This verifies component rendering, not the full authenticated application.

defects: An initially signed-out component retained its sign-in prompt after the real shell session loaded successfully.

shellFollowup.correction: Track the component session transition, refresh the prompt only on signed-out to signed-in, and retain the busy Load gate on same-session refresh. No security guard or financial behavior is relaxed.

checks: Fast/slow synthetic auth boot uses the real load wrapper chain and produces the correct EN/TH ready prompt without a selection change.

Desktop EN navigation to Trade log and back retains the report.
Same-session refresh preserves completed reports and the pending disabled Load button; the delayed report still resolves.
Synthetic session 401 clears pending data, disables Load and prevents the late response from restoring it.
rendered.captures: Four surface checks, a pending/completed refresh case, one additional pending timing capture and one 401 case. Seven network intervals; repeated pending case is not a new feature acceptance.
limitations: Synthetic auth/config/session and ancillary GET fixtures are not real authentication, backend, full-app or target integration acceptance.
All actual index scripts and styles remain; only initial language is injected. Self-only fixture CSP blocks external connections; no target proxy exists.
The market chart endpoints and position levels are deliberately unmodeled and return 404. They are outside this S5-1 verification.
